coverage_claim: Source-grounded Vercy reviewable-draft specification of Product Configuration / Variant aggregate with 12 finding records, 7 functions, 48 questions and 9 qualified sources. Coverage includes identity, lifecycle, relationships, temporal, provenance, ownership, validation, access, interoperability, properties and retention dimensions. Operational implementation, real solver fixtures, executable instance schema, sector-specific profiles and licensed ISO clause inspection remain deferred. No external Claude or Grok research was admitted; single-provider result requires separate no-tools audit and publication hold visible in all artifacts.

boundary_decision.rationale: One reusable configuration revision owns selected assertions and evaluation bindings; family, design, BOM, item, session and offer keep their own masters. Packaging standalone-mm is a separate axis.

decisions.rationale: One reusable configuration revision owns selected assertions and evaluation bindings; family, design, BOM, item, session and offer keep their own masters. Packaging standalone-mm is a separate axis.
REFERENCE explicitly carries CLASSIFIES semantics toward WM-OBJ-001 because the research relation enum has no CLASSIFIES value. No item identity or state is imported.
This model has one 120-second timeout per research provider. Historical policy attempts are not model attempts. Haiku's separate no-tools audit succeeded but no external research result was admitted.

Sources support proposed design choices at declared inspection depth. ISO public abstracts do not establish licensed-clause conformance; neither do vocabulary references establish tested implementation conformance.
The proposed property and capability contracts require evidence, units and conditions. Nominal properties do not describe an instance's observed position, condition or safety.
Four boundary notes retain external design and BOM authority. Selected composition references may qualify occurrences and quantities without taking ownership of the BOM.
Completeness, feasibility, availability and authority are distinct results. Unknown or timed-out evaluation cannot authorize release. Imported expressions require an authorized bounded adapter.
The no-tools audit cannot introduce new source claims or mandate named commercial solvers. Keep a vendor-neutral evaluator profile and defer uninspected domain standards.

No universal lossless mapping is claimed. Required unsupported semantics cause rejection or explicit sidecar handling; retirement retains dependent-item interpretation under access and minimization policy.

publication_holds: Independent Claude and Grok research is absent under owner authorization dated 2026-09-06. Each research attempt timed out once at 120 seconds. A separate Claude Haiku no-tools audit completed; its factual overstatements were corrected transparently by Codex. This remains reviewable-draft, not canonical.

Source/version and claim-level verification remains qualified: Schema.org is a development vocabulary snapshot; ISO 10007 and AP242 were inspected only through public abstracts, not licensed clauses. No normative standards conformance is claimed.
No real-product fixture, executable instance schema, deployed constraint evaluator or tested crosswalk is included. Adoption requires validated target-specific adapters and explicit loss reports.
Physical properties, recognition and capability limits require sector-specific evidence, measurement conditions and uncertainty. The draft provides no certification or safe-actuation authority.
Actual variant creation and release require an owning Dimension with declared roles, access policy, engineering authority and retention rules; the specification does not instantiate that governance.

Target-version mapping and round-trip fixtures, including explicit rule/effectivity sidecars or rejection of unsupported required semantics.
Sector metrology, recognition uncertainty, capability qualification and jurisdiction-specific evidence requirements.
Licensed engineering standards and dictionary inspection before any normative alignment or conformance assertion.
